# Written/refreshed by tests/scripts/run_cosmo_validation.py. Each accepted run
# appends one row per basin: the lsdtt3 inverted rate vs the OCTOPUS-published
# (CAIRN-recalculated) rate
# elevation. Refreshing this file is a REVIEWABLE event (like the CRONUS
# reference) -- a fresh run is compared against these frozen rows as a cheap
# tracked regression check.
# Difference is expected
# CAIRN (Mudd et al. 2016) -- the same algorithm lsdtt-cosmo-tool implements --
# but lsdtt3 has DIVERGED: updated production-rate parameters plus a HIGH-ELEVATION
# production-scaling fix this suite found (the S_tot>=1 clamp defect
# The residual is therefore ELEVATION-DEPENDENT -- elevation_ave_m is recorded per
# basin so the trend is visible. Attribute residual to production params +
# high-elevation scaling + DEM product (COP30 vs SRTM) + pixel binning
# FIRST ACCEPTED RUN frozen 2026-07-24 (keyless COP30 fetch
# threshold_contributing_pixels=250). Measured band on the 12 delineation_reliable
# basins: |pct_diff| <= 9.3% (mean ~5.0%; 11 of the 12 within +/-6.4%

# 1962-3480 m -- the elevation-dependent divergence Simon flagged is within this
# band at COP30 for these basins; elevation_ave_m is kept so a future rerun (or a
# higher/lower DEM) can expose it. A future run is compared against these frozen
# rows as a cheap regression check.
